title: Decomposing the Cost of Complexity Under Risk
abstract: arXiv:2611.09381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study preferences under risk when the probability structure of a lottery can affect value separately from its final prizes. Our first result characterizes perturbed expected utility representation in which lottery value separates into expected utility over prizes and an additive perturbation term depending only on the probability tree. The key behavioral restrictions are branch cancellation, which separates prize evaluation from probability structure, and within-tree dominance, which captures that evaluations within the same probability tree are simple and follow dominance. Strengthening branch cancellation to lottery cancellation, which extends the invariance requirement from common prizes to common sublotteries, characterizes additive separability of the perturbation across branches. translated_title: 分解风险下的复杂性成本
translated_abstract: 我们研究风险下的偏好，此时彩票的概率结构能够独立于其最终奖赏而影响其价值。我们的第一个结果刻画了扰动期望效用表示，其中彩票价值分解为对奖赏的期望效用加上一个仅取决于概率树的加性扰动项。关键的行为公理是分支消去，它将奖赏评估与概率结构分离开来；以及树内支配，它刻画了同一概率树内的评估是简单的并遵循支配关系。将分支消去强化为彩票消去——即把不变性要求从共同奖赏扩展到共同子彩票——刻画了扰动项在各分支之间的加性可分性。我们还刻画了树相关扰动项何时仅取决于不同可能奖赏的数量：在更弱的连续性要求下……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文通过分支消去与树内支配等行为公理，刻画了风险下的扰动期望效用表示，将彩票价值分解为奖赏的期望效用与仅由概率结构复杂性决定的加性扰动成本，并进一步给出了该扰动项仅取决于可能奖赏个数的刻画条件。
en_tdlr: This paper axiomatically characterizes perturbed expected utility representations that decompose a lottery's value into expected utility over prizes plus an additive complexity cost depending only on the probability tree, using branch cancellation and within-tree dominance axioms.
